content: वर्धापनम् [वर्धं छेदं करोति, वृध् णिच्-आप् च ततो भावे ल्युट्] .²1 Cutting, dividing. .²2 Cutting the umbilical cord, or the ceremony connected with this act. .²3 A festival on a birth-day. .²4 A ny festival in general when wishes for prosperity and other congratulatory expressions are offered; <ab>cf.</ab> पूर्णपात्र.
